dataset: Tauranga City Council — Major Building Consent Applications Issued Value over $1m

records.description: Additions and alterations to dwelling - additional bedroom and ensuite on ground floor, new decks and stairs, additional bedroom on first floor, ensuite added to bedroom 1 and kitchen relocated.
Construct two level four bedroom dwelling with attached double garage.
Construction of a new build automatic tunnel carwash with associated office and storage and ancillary vehicle grooming facilities.
Erect 2x two-storey two bedroom dwellings (Units 5,6) - duplex. 1x two-storey three-bedroom dwelling (Unit 1) and 3x two-storey two-bedroom dwellings (Units 2-4) - quadplex.
Erect a three-storey four-bedroom dwelling with attached double garage and decks. Inbuilt solid fuel heater, swimming pool and pool fencing and retaining walls.
Erect a two-storey four-bedroom dwelling with attached double garage and decks.
Installation of racking only for Mitre 10. This consent has a specified intended life of 25 years.
New internal coolrooms and structural steel support in existing supermarket
Structural, Facade and Roof works only for the New Tauranga High and District Court.

Wharenui, Paepae, Sleeping/Store, Wharepaku refurbishment. Replace roofing, new internal linings fixtures. Alteration to roof to rear of Wharenui Sleeping/Store. Extend new roof canopy over increased deck area and Paepae.
